Title: Accelerate Romania |Sales Specialist Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Business Development Description: You help us build the top of our sales funnel for both brands. In 8 weeks you set up a lead generation system that keeps running after you leave: target lists, outbound campaigns, the automation behind them, and clear data on what works. We give direction, you figure out the how. Weeks 1 to 2: you learn our offer, ideal clients and tools, and the first lead list and campaign are ready Weeks 3 to 6: campaigns are live, you test messages and channels and improve what works Weeks 7 to 8: you document the full system so it keeps running, and hand it over About the organisation: QuartzDevs is a software engineering company based in Oradea, Romania. We build web, mobile, data and AI products for startups and established companies across Europe, and we place senior engineers into client teams. We have delivered for GoStudent, Volvo Cars and Save the Children, among others. BuildAID is our AI-assisted product studio. We take founders from idea to a working MVP in weeks, with fixed pricing and short delivery cycles. We are a small, senior team that uses Claude Code, Cursor and modern AI tooling every day. No corporate layers, no approval chains. You work directly with the founder. Preferred skills: Sales, Artificial Intelligence, Negotiation, Client servicing, Business Intelligence Preferred backgrounds: Sales, Business administration What you will learn:

What you will do

  • Build targeted lead lists of our ideal clients: funded startups, product companies and digital agencies in Europe and the US
  • Set up and run 2 to 3 outbound campaigns: cold email sequences, LinkedIn DMs and follow-ups
  • Automate the repetitive parts (Make, Zapier, n8n, Clay, or your own scripts)
  • Support pre-sales: research prospects and prepare call briefs for the founder
  • Create sales material: one-pagers and proposal templates
  • Report every week: what worked, what didn't, what to scale and what to kill

What you bring

  • Projects, internships or side projects in sales, lead generation, growth or business development
  • Technical comfort: you have set up an automation, used no-code tools or worked with large spreadsheets
  • You speak our language, or learn it fast: MVP, SaaS, B2B, proof of concept, web vs. mobile vs. AI development. Terms like React, Next js or API don't scare you. You don't need to code.
  • Proof that you build things: a side project, a vibe-coded app, a scraper, an automated workflow. Show us.
  • You use AI tools daily (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable or similar)
  • A business mindset: you are curious about why a client buys
  • Fluent English (C1 or above). Cold outreach lives or dies on copy.
  • Proactive and fast. You propose, test and report without waiting to be told.

Title: [Impact Brazil] - Project Management Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: [Currently Enrolled Students Only] Be part of a multicultural team, contribute to product innovation, and turn strategic ideas into real solutions while gaining hands-on experience in project management and product development. About the organisation: With over 15,000 employees across 9 countries, Nidec Global Appliance manufactures and commercializes products for home and commercial applications, including refrigeration solutions, motors for washing machines, dryers and dishwashers, as well as components for heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems (HVAC). Its focus is to deliver a complete and innovative portfolio with high standards of quality, reliability, competitiveness and energy efficiency. The division is part of Nidec Corporation, a global leader in motors and components for a wide variety of industries, with headquarters in Japan. Parent company Nidec Corporation was established in Kyoto, Japan in 1973 by its Chairman and CEO Shigenobu Nagamori. In 1979, Nidec became the first company in the world to successfully commercialize a direct drive spindle motor for HDDs based on a brushless DC motor. Since then, the company has grown into a world-leading comprehensive motor manufacturer encompassing more than 300 subsidiaries employing over 100,000 people throughout the world and with annual sales exceeding $13B. Nidec's motors, drives, generators and related products are found in a diverse range of applications including computers, smartphones, home appliances, automobiles, manufacturing plants, robots and more. Required skills: Project Management, Process Engineering Preferred skills: Internet usage, Presentation skills Required backgrounds: Business administration, Electrical engineering, Industrial engineering, Mechanical engineering What you will learn:

Contribute to more efficient project execution by improving management processes, monitoring performance, and exploring innovative solutions.

  • Create project templates to support risk management and reduce product complexity.

  • Monitor project KPIs, track planned vs. actual progress, and identify challenges and roadblocks.

  • Develop agile project management tools to improve team productivity.

  • Explore and propose AI applications for project management.

Expected Results

  • Weekly project KPI monitoring, comparing planned and actual performance.

  • Implementation of project management tools, measured by team adoption and adherence.

Title: Accelerate Romania - Junior Social Media Content Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Marketing Description: We are looking for a creative, motivated, and highly organized Social Media Intern to help us manage and grow 4 distinct Instagram accounts. You’ll be diving into the local hospitality scene and the entrepreneurial world, creating engaging content for our daytime brunch spot (District of Toast), our evening cocktail bar (Antidot), and two personal branding accounts (focused on hospitality management, bartending, behind the bar insights, venue ownership, and entrepreneurship). ​If you are always up to date with the latest Instagram trends, have a good eye for aesthetics, and know how to tell a story through short-form video and photos, this is for you! About the organisation: Small enough to feel personal, quiet enough for real conversation, big enough for up to many guests. The right spot for a first date, a catch-up with friends or peoples next celebration. Preferred skills: Content Marketing, Digital Marketing, Social Media Management, Photoshop Preferred backgrounds: Marketing What you will learn:

What We Are Looking For:

  • Proven knowledge of photo and video editing (familiarity with CapCut, Canva, Lightroom, or similar apps).
  • A strong understanding of Instagram features, algorithms, and current trends.
  • A proactive mindset: we want someone who comes to the table with ideas, not just someone waiting for instructions.
  • Great visual taste and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (knowing Romanian is a plus, but not mandatory).

What We Offer:

  • Portfolio Builder: A solid portfolio built in 2 months, showcasing a diverse range of brands and content styles.
  • Hybrid & Flexible Schedule: Work from wherever you feel inspired when you're not shooting content.
  • Daily Fuel: 1 free meal per day + 1 free lemonade/coffee during your on-site shifts.
  • Team Discount: 50% off everything on our food and drinks menu for you to enjoy.
  • Creative Freedom: A great environment to test your ideas and learn the ins and outs of both the hospitality and business worlds.

What You Will Do:

  • Brainstorm & Plan: Come up with fresh, engaging content ideas tailored to the specific vibe of each account (from relaxed brunch mornings and late-night cocktail mixology to behind-the-scenes venue management).
  • Shoot Content: Visit our locations on-site to capture high-quality photos and videos. Don't worry about the gear - we will provide all the necessary equipment, so you can just focus on bringing the creative vision to life.
  • Edit & Polish: Edit raw footage into dynamic Reels and Stories that catch the eye and fit the brand aesthetics.
  • Manage & Post: Schedule and publish content across the 4 Instagram accounts, ensuring a consistent online presence.
  • Organize & Archive: Keep our digital assets and raw media files neatly organized in our digital archive.
  • Team Syncs: Participate in weekly planning and communication meetings to align on the content calendar.

Work hours

40 hours/week, some shootings need to be done during the day, others during the evening, availability to shoot content during late evening events is also required.

Flexible work, balancing on-site shoots and remote editing.

Title: Automation engineer Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: Design, install, and maintain automated systems by working with PLCs, sensors, control systems, and robotics while troubleshooting technical issues, optimizing system performance, and ensuring safe and efficient operations. About the organisation: SETRA is a leading MEP and HVAC contracting company specializing in Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC Valves. As an authorized distributor of KMC Controls, we offer comprehensive solutions for various projects. With a proven track record Preferred skills: Problem Solving, Analytical thinking, Adaptability Preferred backgrounds: Electrical engineering, Mechanical engineering What you will learn:

  • Design and develop automated systems and processes.

  • Install, test, and maintain automation equipment.

  • Monitor system performance and solve technical problems.

  • Work with PLCs, sensors, control systems, and robotics.

  • Collaborate with engineers and technicians on projects.

  • Ensure systems operate safely and efficiently.

  • Prepare technical reports and system documentation.

Music Without Borders is a four-week Global Volunteer project in Sfax, Tunisia, designed to introduce children aged 6–12 to music through interactive, creative, and culturally enriching activities.

The project creates a welcoming environment where children can explore rhythm, sound, singing, movement, and musical expression while discovering how music connects people across cultures. International volunteers will collaborate with the local organization to prepare and facilitate age-appropriate activities that encourage participation, experimentation, and self-expression. Volunteers will also introduce musical traditions from their home countries, allowing children to discover different cultures and musical styles while celebrating their own heritage.

No previous musical training is required for participating children. Activities will be adapted to their abilities and to the instruments and materials available.

By the end of the project, children are expected to demonstrate greater confidence in musical expression, improved awareness of rhythm and sound, and increased participation in collaborative creative activities.

Project: Discover: Little Skills, Big Futures

Discover is a four-week Global Volunteer project in Sfax, Tunisia, designed to help children aged 6–12 develop essential soft skills through interactive, creative, and experience-based learning.

The project creates a supportive environment where children can explore their strengths, express their ideas, work with others, solve problems, and build confidence. Through educational games, storytelling, role-play, teamwork challenges, creative projects, and guided reflection, children learn practical skills that support their personal development and everyday interactions.

International volunteers will collaborate with the local organization to design and facilitate age-appropriate activities that encourage curiosity, responsibility, empathy, creativity, and positive communication. Rather than relying on traditional classroom teaching, the project emphasizes learning by doing, allowing children to practice new skills in real-life and simulated situations.

Throughout the four weeks, children will explore self-awareness, communication, collaboration, emotional awareness, critical thinking, problem-solving, and responsible decision-making.

By the end of the project, children are expected to demonstrate greater confidence in expressing themselves, improved participation in group activities, and a stronger understanding of how to collaborate respectfully and approach challenges constructively.

Discover your strengths. Build your skills. Shape your future.

The primary objective of this role is to drive market expansion for cutting-edge Agentic AI products by prospecting target companies, identifying qualified contacts, creating tailored outreach scripts, and securing qualified B2B sales meetings. This is an autonomous, results-driven outbound sales role. The specialist must be a proactive self-starter with proven outbound cold calling experience, capable of operating independently without initial training, while incorporating feedback from leadership to optimize outreach efficiency. This role reports directly to the Company Founders / Business Development Lead. About the organisation: Because fun starts when things just work. KPIs:

  • Deliver regular updates and weekly reporting on pipeline growth, call volumes, and meeting bookings directly to leadership.
SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
  • Native fluency in the target market language (e.g., Italian, German, Spanish, etc.) and professional operational English.
  • Strong B2B outbound sales capabilities, including cold calling, handling objections, gatekeeper navigation, and value pitching.

EDUCATION BACKGROUND

PAST WORKING EXPERIENCE

Required Experience:

Title: Junior Hardware Engineer (EPLAN) – Marine Automation (Preferably EU) Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: EPLAN skill required!; Salary may vary based on experience (€1500-2500); Have the intention to stick around after your AIESEC-traineeship. You will contribute to the electrical design of propulsion control systems and cabinets. Initially, you develop and improve existing electrical schematics, taking on increasing responsibility for complete designs and new control cabinet configurations. In this role, you will: ●Create and update electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 / Pro Panel. ●Prepare and maintain bills of materials, terminal diagrams and cable lists. ●Process project and commissioning revisions. ●Develop EPLAN macros, templates and component libraries. ●Coordinate designs, component selection and modular hardware solutions with software, workshop and commissioning engineers. ●Where relevant, join installation, testing and commissioning on board vessels. This is a hands-on role where you will see how your schematics become real control cabinets and how the completed system functions on board. About the organisation: Smart-Ship is a maritime technology company based in Delft, the Netherlands. We develop and supply brand-independent propulsion control systems and haptic control solutions for both newbuild and retrofit projects. Our technology connects vessel operators, propulsion equipment and onboard systems in one integrated control environment. It helps vessels operate more safely and efficiently while enabling future technologies such as remote control, Track Pilot integration, Just-in-Time sailing and increasingly autonomous functions. Our systems are used on inland vessels, ferries, workboats, research vessels and remote-operation applications. We work with shipyards, propulsion manufacturers, vessel owners and maritime technology partners in the Netherlands and internationally. Preferred skills: C#, C++ Preferred backgrounds: Electrical engineering, Electronics engineering, Mechanical engineering What you will learn:

During your first months, you will focus on learning our systems, processing revisions and independently developing parts of an electrical design and macros for our systems in EPLAN Pro Panel.

As your knowledge and experience grow, you can progress towards designing complete control cabinets and electrical installations.

In the longer term, you can play an important role in:

  • Further standardising our EPLAN environment.
  • Developing modular control cabinet configurations.
  • Designing new control systems for engines, thrusters and electric propulsion systems.
  • Component selection and hardware architecture.
  • Improving our engineering and production processes.
  • Taking ownership of hardware projects.
  • Supporting and guiding future colleagues.

Smart-Ship is a compact and growing company, so your development is not limited by a rigid job description. If you demonstrate that you are ready for more responsibility, you will be given the opportunity to take it.

metadata.title: Junior Hardware Engineer (EPLAN) – Marine Automation (Preferably EU)

Title: Power Electronics Internship involving Inverter Experimentation and PSIM Simulation Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: This internship provides an opportunity for a participant to understand the company's specific operations in designing and developing ventilation and disaster prevention monitoring control systems for road tunnels, as well as how the employees perform their duties. Additionally, the participant gains practical experience by applying the specialized knowledge acquired at university to applied tasks such as experiments and programming. Furthermore, through collaborative work in an environment with multinational employees, they can experience cross-cultural exchange. About the organisation: Sohatsu Systems Laboratory was established in April 2000, based in Kobe. Under the company’s management philosophy of valuing trust with the customers and providing people with safe and comfortable environments, the company has contributed to energy conservation and safety in road tunnels. The work of the company involves developing products that leverage the core simulation and sensing technologies to contribute to energy conservation, environmental measures, and improved safety during fires in road tunnels. The company remains committed to contributing to society and meeting public expectations. Required skills: Computer Preferred skills: Programming skills Required backgrounds: Electrical engineering Preferred backgrounds: Computer engineering, Computer sciences What you will learn:
  • Understanding the company and its products related to ventilation and disaster prevention monitoring and control systems for road tunnels based on electrical engineering.

Understanding the companys history, business and target customer base.

Receiving the explanation about the mechanism of the product developed by the company from the internship instructor.

  • Attending an academic seminar hosted by AIESEC in KOBE UNIVERSITY and learning electrical engineering.

Learning electrical engineering through the event inviting a university professor.

  • Experiencing experiments related to inverter ventilation power and simulations using a computer.

Measuring the electrical behavior such as current and voltage for each frequency of the inverter.

Using the simulation software as a tool and performing simulations that reproduce the actual equipment experiments on a computer.

  • Receiving feedback from the company's employees during experiencing the experiments and simulations.

Understanding the experiment purpose, procedures and background through instruction.

Receiving guidance on skills and techniques relevant to the experience.

  • Creating a report on what you learned while gaining an understanding of that company and its product.

Summarizing a report focusing on the comparative analysis of PSIM simulation and actual hardware experiment results.

Receiving feedback about insufficient summarization and comprehension from the employees.

  • Preparing and delivering a final presentation to the companys employees and AIESEC members.

Making a presentation about the overall learning and impressions gained through the internship and how to apply the experience to future activities to the employees and AIESEC members.

About the organisation: Located in the Yeni Batı Mahallesi area, it boasts bright and spacious classrooms with excellent physical conditions. It is a solution-oriented school that fosters the spiritual, physical, and mental development of children, and is a pioneer in morality and love. With a staff that prioritizes pedagogical education, it operates on the principle that "Every child is special," aiming to discover the hidden talents within individuals, make lasting contributions through moral values, and cultivate confident, inquisitive, self-controlled individuals who are at peace with themselves, possess social virtues, embrace moral rules, are faithful, determined, and respectful. The school aims to support development in 8 different areas of intelligence. In this context, considering children's nature, behavior-based learning and project-based education are adopted. Aiming to maximize students' mental, psychological, and physical development, Private Batıkent Bilgi Eli Kindergarten believes in the importance of education through visual, auditory, and kinesthetic (touch, taste, and body-related) activities. Based on the understanding that no child can excel in every area, it observes children and guides them according to their abilities. In our science room, we support the experiential learning model by developing our sensory-visual skills. With our mind game tables, we help children acquire cognitive abilities that appeal to all ages every day. Through program-specific trips and the value of the month appropriate to each month, our children get to know our values ​​very closely. At Özel Batıkent Bilgi Eli Kindergarten, a "Student Development Monitoring Program" is implemented to ensure the targeted developments in education. In this program, measurements are taken for each student that aim not at the recall of information, but at the transformation of information into acquired knowledge. It provides children with the opportunity to develop and improve "Correct Study Habits" by instilling self-discipline. In addition, we get to know the students and observe their developmental stages through portfolio studies where individual developments are monitored, education is supported with personal tests, and the student is recognized as an individual. Play-based learning and play therapy techniques are used to get to know children. We organize drama activities with the contribution of our children to control anger, jealousy, and increase sharing. And we inform our families through family participation. Three full days of English lessons per week. We support our mathematical and sensory intelligence with music (Orff), choir, and folk dance activities. We do activities once a week with mind games tables. We learn coding with robotics coding. Assessment and evaluation studies and picture analysis. Swimming activities. Sensory integration studies. Title: Accelerate Romania - International Fundraising & Friend-Raising Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Business Development Description: The intern will help Dog Assist explore new international markets for fundraising and friend-raising, working alongside the Fundraising & Partnerships team. Drawing on their own cultural background, language, and network, the intern will research, map, and make first contact with companies, foundations, and supporter communities in countries or regions that are new to Dog Assist - identifying where there is real openness to supporting this kind of cause. This role does not replace, but complements, the work of the team's Fundraising & Partnerships Officer, adding a research and international-opening capacity the local team does not have time to cover on its own. About the organisation: Dog Assist is a Romanian organization based in Cluj-Napoca providing animal-assisted services (with therapy dogs and alpacas) for neurodivergent children, at-risk teenagers, parents, and educators, with the mission that no child is left behind for financial reasons. Our programs take place in educational centers, hospitals, and our own therapy clinic, and are evidence-based, developed in collaboration with universities. Our team includes social workers, therapists, dog handlers, and physiotherapists. Preferred skills: Writing, Research, Analytical thinking, Organisational Management, Sales, Negotiation Preferred backgrounds: International relations, Marketing, Business administration What you will learn:

  1. Market Research & Cultural Mapping. Research giving/philanthropy culture and corporate social responsibility (CSR) practices in relevant countries or regions - including, where relevant, the intern's own country or region Identify digital fundraising platforms, donation habits, and seasonality specific to each market Document culturl differences relevant to how Dog Assist should approach fundraising and friendraising there
  2. Geographic Prioritization. Help build a simple market-scoring framework (openness, accessibility, diaspora / animal-loving community presence, online payment infrastructure) Propose 2-3 pilot markets, with reasoning, for Dog Assist's international fundraising direction
  3. Initial International Outreach. Identify companies, foundations, and potential supporter communities (expats, diaspora, dog/animal lovers) in the prioritized markets Initiate first contact (email, LinkedIn, social media), culturally and linguistically adapted Populate the existing CRM with the contacts and information gathered
  4. Digital Friendraising. Help build an online community of international supporters through culturally adapted content and messaging Support crowdfunding / peer-to-peer campaigns aimed at international audiences Work with the marketing team to adapt Dog Assist's key messages for international audiences, keeping the organization's tone - warm and credible, free of pity-based storytelling or unrealistic therapeutic promises
  5. Support to the Fundraising & Partnerships Team. Support the local team with research, material preparation, and translation/adaptation of messages Take part in internal alignment and strategy meetings 
  6. Documentation & Handover. Document the research methodology and findings in a simple market-opening playbook, per country/region explored - a deliverable that stays with the team after the internship ends Success Indicators (indicative) Number of markets/countries researched and documented Clarity and usefulness of the final market playbook delivered Number of international contacts initiated (companies / foundations / communities) Contribution to at least one digital friend-raising campaign

Title: Growth and market expansion intern | Accelerate Serbia Programme: Global Talent Field: Business Development Description: Inclusio is a social innovation startup making services more accessible for people with disabilities. As we expand across Europe, we are looking for a Growth & Market Expansion Intern for an 8-week program. You will work with our Growth Manager, Founder, and CEO on international expansion. Your tasks will include researching your local market, mapping competitors, identifying potential clients and partners, and creating market entry recommendations. You will gain hands-on experience in business development, market research, strategy, partnerships, and startup growth. We are looking for someone proactive, curious, fluent in English, familiar with their local market, and comfortable with independent research. No previous accessibility experience is required. If you are interested in entrepreneurship, innovation, and creating impact, this is a great opportunity to gain practical startup experience and contribute to Inclusio’s international growth. About the organisation: Inclusio enables people with disabilities to independently access on-site services at locations such as banks, grocery stores, pharmacies, and other public or private sector facilities. When trying to reach these services on their own, people with disabilities need assistance from employees, but first have to overcome a range of barriers that vary depending on the type of disability, from revolving doors to crowded spaces. The core problem is that even though frontline employees are willing to help, they are often unaware of the individual approaching them or of that person's specific needs. Inclusio solves this gap by making sure employees are informed in advance about the arrival and specific requirements of a person with a disability. We do this through two connected applications: a partner application used by staff at the location, and a consumer application used by the person with a disability to announce their visit. The consumer app is free of charge, while partner organizations pay Inclusio on a monthly, per-location subscription basis. In practice, users signal their arrival through the app, prompting the partner location to prepare tailored assistance before the person even enters. For our partners, subscribing to Inclusio delivers value across several business dimensions: it strengthens brand reputation and supports marketing efforts by positioning the organization as genuinely inclusive; it drives sales growth and customer loyalty by opening access to a large, underserved customer segment; and it provides measurable, demonstrable progress toward ESG compliance and CSR commitments. Our clients include both private businesses and public institutions, reflecting the broad relevance of accessibility across sectors. We currently partner with OTP Bank, A1 Telco, and the City of Kragujevac, and are actively working to expand into additional sectors such as retail and hospitality. We have been building Inclusio since 2022, supported along the way by several grants and multiple awards, including being recognized with the title of Best Technology Innovation by the Republic of Serbia. Our growth strategy focuses on scaling these partnerships both locally and internationally, with an initial geographic focus on Europe and Asia. Our target user base consists of individuals aged 15 to 45 who own a smartphone with a data plan, value their independence despite living with a disability, and are often connected to organizations that support people with disabilities. On the business side, our ideal customers are growing or multinational companies and public institutions with branch or retail networks, whether headquartered in Serbia, elsewhere in Europe, or globally. Our client base is not geographically limited, and we are actively pursuing partnerships across multiple markets as part of our international expansion strategy. By connecting these two sides of the market, Inclusio empowers individuals with disabilities to navigate everyday services independently, while enabling businesses and institutions to grow their customer base and strengthen their market position. Required skills: Market Research, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Presentation skills, Communication Required backgrounds: Business administration, Economics, Marketing What you will learn:

- Market Research & Analysis

- Potential Client Mapping

- Reseller & Distributor Mapping

- Accessibility Ecosystem & Associations

- Outreach & Meetings

- Participation in Strategic Meetings

- Market Entry Strategy

Title: Nutraceutical Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: Krismatic Naturals provides an intensive summer internship offering hands-on training in Nutraceuticals, Functional Foods, Functional Beverages, Product Formulation, Product Evaluation, Quality Control, and Quality Assurance. The program bridges academic knowledge with practical industry applications through a project-based experiential learning approach, enabling students to conceptualize, develop, optimize, evaluate, and document innovative nutraceutical and functional food products. Participants gain practical exposure to iron-fortified chocolates, prebiotic- and probiotic-based products, functional chocolates, nutraceutical formulations, and functional beverages. The training covers the selection and incorporation of vitamins, minerals, herbal ingredients, bioactive compounds, prebiotics, probiotics, and other functional ingredients, together with formulation optimization, ingredient compatibility, sensory considerations, stability, packaging, and storage. About the organisation: Accredited by NAAC with “A+” grade, KIET Group of Institutions is undoubtedly one of the top Engineering Colleges in Delhi-NCR. 3rd rank among “Private Institutions (Technical)” in India in Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements, ARIIA-2021, and its NBA-accredited eligible courses also add to the credibility of the institute. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow and approved by AICTE. With the glorious legacy of 25 years in Engineering, Pharmacy, Management and Computer Application education. KIET has successfully contributed to the multidimensional development of future professionals. Required skills: Critical Thinking Preferred backgrounds: Nutrition, Bioengineering What you will learn:
  • To develop practical skills in nutraceutical and functional food formulation, product development, optimization, evaluation, and quality assessment.
  • To provide hands-on training in developing innovative products such as iron-fortified chocolates, functional chocolates, prebiotic and probiotic products, and functional beverages.
  • To familiarize students with the selection and incorporation of vitamins, minerals, herbal ingredients, bioactive compounds, prebiotics, probiotics, and other functional ingredients.
  • To provide practical exposure to fortification strategies, ingredient compatibility, formulation optimization, sensory considerations, stability, packaging, and storage.
  • To develop skills in physicochemical and quality evaluation of fianctional food and nutraceutical products, including relevant stability and microbial-quality assessments.
  • To familiarize students with GMP, GLP, SOPS, documentation, Quality Control, Quality Assurance, and basic regulatory considerations applicable to nutraceutical and functional food development.

Title: EV Technology & CS Intern Programme: Global Talent Description: Job Description The participant will work on a university-facilitated project focused on Electric Vehicle Technology and Control Systems, based on concepts covered within MMDU's Electrical Engineering curriculum. The project will involve academic research, technical analysis, modelling/simulation, and documentation under faculty supervision. The project will conclude with a structured report and presentation. Title: Cambridge English Teacher Programme: Global Teacher Description: We are seeking an enthusiastic, dynamic, and experienced English Language Teacher to deliver Cambridge Young Learners (Pre-A1 Starters, A1 Movers, A2 Flyers) and Cambridge Main Suite (A2 Key / KET, B1 Preliminary / PET) programs. The ideal candidate will possess a strong command of UK English, interactive teaching methodologies, and a proven track record of preparing Sri Lankan students for Cambridge Assessment English examinations. Working Hours: Interns are required to be present during their assigned classes and related duties. The final teaching schedule will be shared upon selection, and the total working hours will be within 45 hours per week, in accordance with AIESEC standards. About the organisation: British Trinity Academy of English (BTAE) is an English language education institute dedicated to helping learners develop their English communication skills and confidence. The academy provides English language training for a diverse range of students, from children to young adults, with a strong focus on practical communication and spoken English proficiency. Required skills: Language Teaching, Presentation skills Required backgrounds: Languages What you will learn:

Key Requirements & Qualifications

Education: Bachelors Degree in English, ELT, Education, or Linguistics from a recognized university, or an equivalent professional qualification (e.g., TKT, CELTA, TESOL, or Higher National Diploma in English).

Teaching Experience: Minimum 12 years of experience teaching Cambridge English curricula (Starters, Movers, Flyers, KET, PET) in a reputed school or language institute.

Language Proficiency: Native or near-native fluency in written and spoken UK English. Knowledge of local context/languages (Sinhala) to assist lower-level young learners is an advantage.

Exam Knowledge: Familiarity with current Cambridge English exam structures, question patterns, and official assessment criteria.

Skills: Excellent classroom presentation skills, patience with young children, strong organizational ability, and proficiency with digital tools/audio equipment for listening tasks.

Key Responsibilities

Curriculum Delivery: Plan and deliver engaging, student-centered lessons aligned with Cambridge Assessment English frameworks (CEFR Pre-A1 to B1 levels).

Exam Preparation: Train students in the four core language skillsReading, Writing, Listening, and Speakingspecifically targeting Cambridge YLE, KET, and PET exam formats, timing, and marking criteria.

Interactive Methodology: Conduct high-energy, communicative activities, roleplays, and vocabulary games to encourage active student participation and reduce teacher talk time.

Assessment & Progress Tracking: Administer regular mock tests, evaluate past papers, maintain accurate progress records, and provide constructive feedback to students and parents.

Classroom Management: Maintain an encouraging, disciplined, and age-appropriate learning environment for young learners (ages 611 for YLE) and teens (ages 1215 for KET/PET).

Parent Communication: Conduct periodic academic updates with parents to discuss student development, exam readiness, and areas for improvement.

Material Preparation: Develop supplementary worksheets, flashcards, audio exercises, and revision guides tailored to local learning needs using British English standards.

Note about work hour: Teachers are required to work from Monday to Saturday. One Saturday each month is reserved for internal training, which is not compulsory for foreign teachers. Due to the nature of early childhood education, the school may organize events or festivals on Sundays, in which all staff members are required to participate. Staff are entitled to a seven-day summer holiday, running from Sunday to Saturday. Title: English Teacher Programme: Global Teacher Description: The primary role of the teacher in a multidimensional language class is to establish conditions and develop activities so that students are able to practise the language in a meaningful context. (Çok boyutlu bir dil sınıfında öğretmenin birincil rolü, öğrencilerin dili anlamlı bir bağlamda uygulayabilmeleri için koşullar oluşturmak ve etkinlikler geliştirmektir.) About the organisation: About Us Today’s children often begin their educational journey with strong self-expression and language skills in the preschool years. However, when they enter kindergarten—especially in crowded and passive classroom environments—they may become more withdrawn, experience academic difficulties, and struggle to express themselves confidently. In addition, excessive exposure to digital devices such as computers, tablets, and smartphones at home can impact children’s ability to focus, follow instructions, manage attention, and adapt to school routines and peer relationships. We recognize that children cannot be held responsible for these challenges. As adults, our responsibility is not only to identify the problem but also to create meaningful solutions. We believe that education should not be limited to academic performance alone. Instead of focusing solely on memorization and statistics, learning should nurture creativity, skills, individuality, and the ability to access and apply knowledge effectively. Our approach is built on the belief that children learn best through experience — by playing, exploring, creating, and producing. When children feel capable and successful, their confidence grows, and success becomes a natural outcome. Our mission is to make achievement, production, development, and creativity a lifelong habit. Our Approach We support holistic development through play-based, experience-centered learning environments: Physical Development Through Play Encouraging movement and motor development without rigid sports rules, allowing children to strengthen their bodies naturally through active play. What you will gain:

Skills in designing interactive learning experiences

Insight into negotiation, conflict resolution, and stakeholder dynamics

A creative, hands-on project with real-world relevance

Title: Accelerate Romania - Biodiversity governance in agricultural landscapes Programme: Global Talent Description: We are offering a research opportunity for Master’s and PhD students to explore the root causes of biodiversity decline in agricultural landscapes across Europe. You will work with major EU policy frameworks, including the European Green Deal, CAP, the Farm to Fork Strategy, and the EU Biodiversity Strategy. You will investigate the indirect drivers and underlying causes of biodiversity decline in agricultural landscapes, focusing on EU and Member State frameworks, and contribute to an ongoing Horizon-funded international project. What you’ll gain: Experience in international research collaboration Exposure to EU policymaking and sustainability strategies Involvement in policy analysis, interdisciplinary research Opportunity to contribute to impactful environmental solutions About the organisation: The Faculty of Business is the first Romanian higher education institution to offer specialized degree programs in the field of business. Policy Analysis & Evaluation: Examining major EU policy frameworks, specifically the European Green Deal, the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP), the Farm to Fork Strategy, and the EU Biodiversity Strategy.

Scientific Investigation: Researching the root causes, indirect drivers, and underlying factors contributing to biodiversity decline in European agricultural landscapes.

Regulatory Research: Analyzing environmental frameworks at both the EU level and the individual Member State level.

International Collaboration: Contributing to an ongoing Horizon-funded international project and working alongside global research partners.

Interdisciplinary Synthesis: Integrating policy analysis with environmental science to develop impactful solutions for sustainability.

Strategic Reporting: Assisting in the development of research outputs that bridge the gap between academic findings and practical EU policymaking.

Title: Accelerate Romania - Market Development Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Business Development Description: We have a strong value proposition and proven results. What we lack is visibility in key European markets. Today, decision-makers in France, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden, and Luxembourg searching for an outsourcing partner are unlikely to find us. This intern's mission is to change that by creating a high-value content asset and building the visibility needed to make Horyzon credible, discoverable, and trusted. The goal is simple: create the most useful resource for COOs, CFOs, Managing Directors, and other leaders at mid-sized companies considering outsourcing for the first time. Every activity during this internship—from content creation and SEO to backlink building and thought leadership—should contribute to making Horyzon the company buyers find, trust, and contact. About the organisation: Horyzon Network is a Cluj-based outsourcing and KPO firm providing remote operational teams and process infrastructure to mid-market companies. We handle the operational heavy lifting — sales support, back-office, data analytics, process optimization — so our clients can scale without friction. We are now building our presence in France and need someone who understands the French business world from the inside. Preferred skills: Sales, Communication, Business Intelligence Preferred backgrounds: Business administration, Communication & journalism What you will learn:

Phase 1 — Intelligence (weeks 1-2)

You know the French business world. Use that knowledge systematically. Research how French mid-market decision-makers actually search for and evaluate outsourcing providers — on Google, on ChatGPT, on Perplexity, in professional networks. Document the exact language they use, the questions they ask, the objections they have, the competitors who appear. Benchmark the content that currently ranks or gets cited. Deliver a structured brief that defines the content we need to build and why.

This phase ends with one document: a complete editorial brief that we both validate before a single word of content is written.

Phase 2 — Content Creation (weeks 3-6)

Write the guide. In French. For a senior French business audience. This is not a brochure or a service page — it is a substantive, useful resource that earns trust before it asks for anything. Think of it as the document you would want to read if you were a Directeur Opérations at a 200-person French industrial company wondering whether outsourcing your sales administration makes sense.

Structure, depth, and business register matter enormously here. You are the quality filter — if it would not be credible to a French executive, it does not ship.

Phase 3 — Distribution & Citation (weeks 6-7)

A great piece of content that no one links to or cites does not exist in search. Your job in this phase is to get Horyzon mentioned on the external sources that French buyers and AI tools use to verify providers. Complete Clutch and Kompass profiles in French with real case study language. Identify three to five French professional publications, industry associations, or business media where Horyzon could earn a citation or contributed placement. Produce a prioritized list with contacts and a suggested approach for each that we action together.

Phase 4 — Handover (week 8)

Document everything. What you found, what you built, what worked, what still needs to be done. Produce a 90-day continuation plan that is specific enough for someone with no prior context to pick up and execute. This document is treated with the same seriousness as the content asset itself.

The Profile We Need

You are a French native, currently studying in France at Bachelor final year or Master 1 level, in Business, Marketing, Communications, or International Management.

You write French at a professional business register. Not student French. Not social media French. The kind of French a DAF reads and does not wince at.

You are intellectually rigorous. The first two weeks of this internship are research and analysis, not production. You are comfortable producing structured written work before moving to execution.

You understand the French business landscape. You know what an ETI is, how French companies are structured, what les directions opérationnelles actually worry about, and how B2B purchasing decisions get made in France. This is not something we can teach you in 2 months.

You work in English comfortably.Internal communication, briefings, and coordination with the team are in English.

You do not need to be told what to do every day.You will have clear objectives, a weekly check-in, and direct access to the founder. Within that structure you are expected to manage your own time and flag blockers early.

What This Is Not

This is not a social media management role. It is not a translation job. It is not administrative support. If your expectation is to manage an Instagram calendar or translate existing English pages word for word, this is the wrong opportunity.

What You Get

You work directly with the founder of a growing international outsourcing firm. Your output ships  it will be live, representing the company in your home market. You leave with a portfolio piece that demonstrates strategic market research and senior B2B content development in a real commercial context. That is genuinely rare at this stage of a career.

Title: Electrical Engineer Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: Exchange Participant is responsible to apply the principles of electricity, electronics, and electromagnetism to develop electrical products and systems. They perform risk assessments and ensure compliance with safety standards and electrical engineering codes. They also conduct research to create new applications. About the organisation: We prevent interruptions to your operations by providing maintenance and repair services for your transformers. ETM Engineering was established on April 1, 2004, to operate in the fields of electrical projects, high-voltage installations, and energy. In this context, it has completed many medium and large-scale projects. It works with the best team in the region regarding high voltage, maintenance and repair, and the continuity of the facility. Our constantly improving team enthusiastically follows advancing technology while producing and implementing different alternatives in the field of energy monitoring and continuity. Required skills: Auto-CAD, Programming skills, Machine Elements Required backgrounds: Electrical engineering What you will learn:

1. Design, maintain, implement, or improve electrical instruments, facilities, components, equipment products, or systems for industrial, commercial or domestic purposes.

2. Perform a wide range of engineering tasks by operating computer-assisted design or engineering software and equipment. 

3. Confer with customers, engineers, and others to discuss existing or potential engineering products or projects.

4. Ensure that installation and operations conform to standards and customer requirements by preparing electrical systems specifications, technical drawings or topographical maps.

5. Establish construction, manufacturing or installation standards or specifications by performing a wide range of detailed calculations.

6. Ensure compliance with specifications, codes, or customer requirements by directing or coordinating installation, manufacturing, construction, maintenance, documentation, support or testing activities.

7. Write reports and compiling data regarding existing and potential electrical engineering projects and studies.

8. Prepare specifications for purchases of electrical equipment and materials. Supervise or training project team members. 

9. Estimate material, labor, or construction costs for budget preparation.

10. Maintain electrical equipment. 

11. Work with a variety of technicians.

Title: Architecture Intern Programme: Global Talent Description: Biophilic design offers a way to reconnect people with nature in urban environments by integrating natural elements into built spaces. Based on the Biophilia Hypothesis, it enhances well-being, cognitive performance, and user experience. It can be applied across schools, homes, commercial, and public spaces, but a key challenge is translating theory into practical, context-specific design strategies and evaluation methods. This study explores how biophilic principles can be systematically implemented to create healthier, sustainable, and human-centered environment. Title: Biotechnology Intern Programme: Global Talent Description: PET from single-use plastics severely pollutes the environment and disrupts human endocrine systems. To combat this, our project investigates PET-degrading bacteria from waste sites, focusing on PETase—a novel esterase enzyme with disulfide bonds that bind and hydrolyze PET into MHET. This further breaks down into ethylene glycol (entering the TCA cycle as acetate) and terephthalic acid (metabolized via the beta-ketoadipate pathway). Interns will drive sustainable bioremediation efforts by performing PET biodegradation and evaluating fermentation kinetics to enhance PETase production for scale-up, utilizing basic microbiology and fermentation technology. Through structured execution, interns will gain hands-on research and problem-solving experience, refining their analytical and communication skills while learning to translate complex academic problem statements into clear, testable, and professionally documented outcomes. About the organisation: M.A.H.E. is a premier research institute in various disciplines and has been awarded the "institute of eminence" title. Found in 1953, M.A.H.E. has pioneered education and has been the alma mater for many successful individuals. Required skills: Research, Detail oriented, Problem Solving, Data Analysis, Communication Required backgrounds: Biology, Chemistry, Chemical engineering What you will learn:

1. Review the project brief, objectives, and supporting material to understand the scope and expected outcome.

2. Carry out the main task described in the submission, including biodegradation of pet toreduce its adverse effects on the environment. evaluation of fermentation kinetic parameters for an enhanced petase production for further scale-up process.

3. Develop, implement, or refine the central solution for biotechnology, pharmaceutical,environmental technology, enzyme technology, microbiolgy, bioprocess, whether that involves a model, prototype, simulation, or analytical workflow.

4. Test and evaluate intermediate results, compare alternatives, and improve the approach based on performance or observations.

5. Document methods, assumptions, findings, and final results for reporting, discussion, or publication.

Title: Power Systems Research Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: As a Summer Intern on technoeconomic analysis of microgrids, you will work at the intersection of electrical engineering, energy economics, and data-driven decisions. About the organisation: Einstein’s English Lab is an institute dedicated to teaching the English language in the city of La Rioja. Cause: By 2030, ensure that all youth and a substantial proportion of adults, both men and women, achieve literacy and numeracy Required skills: Communication, Collaboration, Adaptability, Professional Skills, Personal skills and knowledge, Language Teaching, Leadership, Solution Orientation, Google Drive, Facilitation, Problem Solving, Project Management Required backgrounds: Education, Computer sciences What you will learn:
  • Activity 1: Facilitation of Challenge-Based Conversation Workshops (STEAM Talk Series): The native teacher will lead debate and problem-solving sessions on global trends in science, technology and art, encouraging students to use English as a tool to propose solutions, not just to repeat grammar.
  • Activity 2: Linguistic Mentoring in Experimental Projects (Project-Based Learning Support): Provide real-time support and feedback as students develop prototypes, experiments or digital presentations, ensuring that technical terminology and the naturalness of the language are organically integrated into the creative process.

Title: Interpreter Programme: Global Talent Description: Exchange Participant is responsible for facilitating communication between parties who speak two different languages. He/she will do this by interpreting, translating and re-communicating both verbal and written messages from one language into another. About the organisation: OUR VISION To become a leading brand in Turkey and international markets, preferred in the textile, paper, and adhesives sectors, by combining our expertise in the field of chemistry with innovative, sustainable, and reliable solutions. We aim to be a company that leads the sector with environmentally and human-friendly chemical solutions, building the production understanding of the future today. OUR MISSION In the fields of textile auxiliary chemicals, paper chemicals, and adhesives; to contribute to the efficiency of the industry by developing high-performance, high-quality, and value-added products that accurately analyze customer needs. With our R&D-focused approach, technical support, and ethical work understanding; we aim to be a reliable, sustainable, and solution-oriented business partner for our business partners. OUR QUALITY POLICY At Kraft Kimya, we consider quality a fundamental principle not only in our products but also in all our processes. In this regard; We are committed to: Producing our products in accordance with international quality standards, Improving our processes with a continuous improvement approach, Offering stable and reliable products that fully meet customer expectations, Adopting an environmentally conscious production approach that prioritizes human health, Supporting the training and development of our employees by increasing their quality awareness, Complying fully with legal and regulatory requirements. For Kraft Kimya, quality is not just a goal; it is an integral part of our corporate culture. Required skills: Professional Skills, Client servicing, Communication, Facilitation, Presentation skills Required backgrounds: Business administration, Languages What you will learn:

1. Translate Verbal Communications in real time. (e.g. conferences, events, meetings, classes and training sessions, or individual communications).

2. Translate Written Communications (e.g. documents, forms, meeting notes, emails, presentations). 

3. Assist Clients by facilitate communications by assisting clients on behalf of their company. 

4. Document and record interactions and translations.

5. Acting as Interpreter between a wide range of people with diverse voices, accents, speaking tempos and personalities. 

6. Providing parties with clear and exact translations of written materials, and interpretations of verbal communication. 

7. Providing interpretations of questions, answers, statements, arguments, explanations and other forms of verbal communication.

8. Rendering sight translations of documents and other written materials.

9. Imparting thought, purpose, spirit, emotions and tone of speakers from source language into target language. 

10. Interpreting with no additions or omissions.

  • Utilize audio/video resources and Center Facilities, such as Center's Lab, TV, Projector, and Internet resources to enhance the learning experience.
  • Prepare lessons and required equipment ahead of each class.
  • Take responsibility for students welfare and progress
  • Inform students of the Center's objectives and aspirations.

2

Teaching-Related Responsibilities:

  • Administer, evaluate, and offer timely, constructive feedback while recording students' progress reports, tests, and assessments.
  • Create and utilize appropriate supplementary materials as needed to enhance the learning experience.

3

Administrative Work and Projects:

  • Contribute to the development of the English language program. This may involve papating in curriculum design, educational projects, and other administrative tasks aimed at improving the overall learning experience.
  • Contribute to the placement testing and interview process for new students.
  • Engage in or organize teaching-related activities, including demos, conversation clubs, tutorials, seminars, workshops and extracurricular events.
  • Assist in marketing activities and participate in the Center's social events.

4

Flexibility in Substitution:

  • Be ready to substitute for absent colleagues, either on-site or off-site, even at short notice.

5

Collaborate with Leaders and colleagues:

  • Work closely with the Principal, DOS and colleagues to ensure effective communication and operational efficiency.

6

Follow Administrative Procedures:

  • Familiarize yourself with the administrative protocols of the Center.
  • Ensure the teachers' room, equipment, and resources are well-organized and maintained.

7

Professional Development

  • Continuously self-assess performance and progress.
  • Attend and actively participate in teacher development workshops provided by the Center.
  • Engage in reciprocal observations with both the DOS and fellow teaching colleagues.
  • Proactively enhance teaching skills by exchanging knowledge with colleagues and utilizing teaching resources available within the Center, on the Internet, and from other accessible sources.

8. The employees will work from Monday to Saturday with flexible days off and the working schedule above will be flexible and adjusted before announcing it to the employee. The employee is also expected to perform administration work for the company alongside with the teaching job.

9. The centre support 50% Visa fee, 100% Work Permit and Temporary Residence Card fees

10. The salary will the $1200/110h and will be paid from 7th to 10th each month

Title: Sustainability Outreach & Community Development Specialist Programme: Global Talent Description: The Sustainability Outreach & Community Development Specialist will support a Hyderabad-based NGO in promoting sustainable lifestyles and responsible consumption among community beneficiaries. The intern will research sustainable agricultural and eco-friendly practices, facilitate awareness activities, conduct workshops, and design interactive experiences that encourage environmentally conscious daily habits. The role contributes to SDG 12 – Responsible Consumption and Production, ensuring people have the knowledge to adopt sustainable living in harmony with nature. About the organisation: Krishna Sadan is a charitable organization led by professional social workers in Hyderabad, India, dedicated to serving elderly individuals who lack family support or financial resources. Rooted in compassion and community care, Krishna Sadan provides nutritious food, safe and modest accommodation, and essential health services — all completely free of cost. With a mission to offer dignity, comfort, and belonging in the later stages of life, Krishna Sadan supports its “chosen elders” by fostering an environment where they feel respected, cared for, and emotionally secure. The organization continues to stand as a model of social responsibility by ensuring that vulnerable senior citizens receive the love, support, and quality of life they truly deserve. Required skills: Adaptability, Time Management, Strategic Planning, Communication Required backgrounds: Business administration What you will learn:
  • Participate in onboarding sessions with the NGO to understand beneficiaries, current practices, and project expectations.
  • Conduct an initial assessment to benchmark the communitys current awareness level of sustainability.
  • Plan weekly sustainable-lifestyle learning activities and collect feedback from NGO partners and AIESEC.
  • Shadow NGO partners to learn about current agriculture methods and ongoing sustainability initiatives.
  • Research and analyze good sustainable agriculture practices from studies and global case examples.
  • Conduct workshops with NGO partners to present and discuss best practices and co-create improvement strategies.
  • Participate in fieldwork activities related to sustainable farming and animal welfare.
  • Capture field activity documentation (photos/videos) and create awareness content (reels/posts) for social media campaigns.
  • Design and implement outdoor learning activities with children, teens, and adults (e.g., treasure hunts in nature, recycling art projects, fitness-based sustainable activities).
  • Facilitate round-table discussions on everyday responsible consumption, including water and energy use, food waste, fashion sustainability, recycling and device lifespan.
  • Conduct training sessions demonstrating simple recycling and eco-friendly lifestyle habits for beneficiaries.
  • Document sustainable practices introduced and adopted throughout the project period.
  • Collect qualitative and quantitative feedback from beneficiaries using surveys, interviews, and focus groups.
  • Analyze progress and measure post-project awareness to identify impact outcomes.
  • Prepare a comprehensive project impact report and present it to AIESEC and NGO partners.
  • Participate in the final closing ceremony with beneficiaries and debrief insights, successes, and recommendations for future continuity.

About the organisation: Serving the construction and excavation sectors since 1986, our company has combined its experience with the construction equipment sector since 1997. Doğan İş Makinaları has adopted the principle of providing professional solutions to customer needs and has defined its operating principles accordingly. Based on this principle, we possess the technical equipment to meet our customers' needs seamlessly and economically. To better serve our customers, we strengthen our equipment with expert personnel equipped with the necessary knowledge and state-of-the-art machinery that meets the demands of the present day. We constantly monitor new technologies and strengthen our knowledge through necessary training, thus constantly improving our skills. Doğan İş Makinaları serves customers in the construction, excavation, marble, and mining sectors, manufacturing buckets, rippers, quick couplers, crusher brackets, marble separators, loader buckets, marble lifting forks, single teeth, and attachments. We also offer all kinds of custom manufacturing and repair services for damaged equipment. Doğan İş Makinaları, with its expert team of engineers and workers, is always at your service. Our company, Doğan İnşaat & Hafriyat, has been operating in the construction sector for years and has proven its long-standing commitment to excavation, transportation, and construction projects. Our Mission: To help companies increase their productivity by ensuring they utilize construction equipment technologies in the best possible way. Our Vision: To be one of the internationally preferred companies providing solutions in the construction equipment sector. Our Principles: To be honest under all circumstances. To earn and maintain the trust of our customers. To strive to be the best in our field. To constantly monitor innovations. To embrace our customers' work as if it were our own. (Kamuoyu yoklamalar, anketler ve anketler dahil olmak zere veri toplamann yollarn gelitirin ve deerlendirin.) 5. Collect data on market conditions, competitors, and consumers, and consolidate information into actionable items, reports and presentations. (Piyasa koullar, rakipler ve tketiciler hakknda veri toplayn ve bilgileri eyleme dntrlebilir eler, raporlar ve sunumlar halinde birletirin.) 6. Analyze collected data with statistical software. Title: AI and IOT/ Machine Learning Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: Combining Machine Learning (ML) with the Internet of Things (IoT) opens up a vast field of innovative applications, from smart homes and healthcare to industrial automation and environmental monitoring. Integrating ML into IoT devices and systems involves collecting data from various sensors, processing this data (often in real-time), and using it to make predictions or decisions autonomously. Given the interdisciplinary nature of ML with IoT, the roles involved in this field are diverse, covering aspects of hardware design, software development, data science, and system architecture. The intern will also leverage the power of NVIDIA CUDA processors specifically designed for high-performance computing and deep learning optimization on NVIDIA GPUs. The aim is to develop a unique blend of skills across hardware and software engineering specific but not limited to IoT devices, emphasizing proficiency with CUDA and GPU-accelerated computing. About the organisation: Accredited by NAAC with “A+” grade, KIET Group of Institutions is undoubtedly one of the top Engineering Colleges in Delhi-NCR. 3rd rank among “Private Institutions (Technical)” in India in Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements, ARIIA-2021, and its NBA-accredited eligible courses also add to the credibility of the institute. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow and approved by AICTE. With the glorious legacy of 25 years in Engineering, Pharmacy, Management and Computer Application education, KIET has successfully contributed to the multidimensional development of future profesionales. Required skills: Python Preferred skills: Software Development Frameworks, C++, C, R Preferred backgrounds: Computer sciences What you will learn:
  • Design, Implement and optimize ML models for deployment on NVIDIA GPUs using CUDA and libraries like cuDNN. Adapt existing ML algorithms for parallel processing to enhance performance and efficiency in training and inference phase.
  • Develop and optimize embedded systems software for IoT devices with NVIDIA Jetson module or other CUDA-capable devices.
  • Design the overall system architecture for ML-powered IoT solutions, integrating CUDA-accelerated processing units for both edge and cloud computing.
  • Conduct research on new ML algorithms that can be optimized for CUDA GPUs, focusing on applications in IoT contexts such as smart cities, healthcare, and industrial automation. Publish findings and contribute to the advancement of GPU-accelerated ML research.

Title: Inventory Management Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Business Administration Description: The Inventory Management Intern assists in the efficient operation of inventory management tasks by supporting the team in monitoring stock levels, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring smooth flow of goods within the warehouse or distribution center. Assist in tracking and managing inventory levels, ensuring accurate stock counts. Support in organizing and maintaining inventory records in the inventory management system. Support inventory audits by preparing required documents and assisting in physical counts. Collaborate with the team to monitor stock movement and reorder products as needed. Assist in tracking stock discrepancies and investigating potential issues. Help generate inventory reports and assist in analyzing stock data. Provide assistance in maintaining a clean and organized inventory area. Support the team in managing product returns and exchanges. About the organisation: Frozen Meat and Seafood Supplier in the Philippines Consistent Frozen Solutions is the leading frozen meat supplier in the Philippines, trusted by the top restaurants, meat processors, and supermarkets. We provide an easy and hassle-free buying experience that gives our customers peace of mind. Required skills: Analytical thinking, Collaboration, Communication, Critical Thinking, Data Analysis, Data Analytics, Data Management, Data Science, Database Management, ERP, Leadership, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Powerpoint, Microsoft Word, Organisational Management, Presentation skills, Problem Solving, Process Engineering, Supply Chain management, Project Management Required backgrounds: Industrial engineering Preferred backgrounds: Mechanical engineering, Business administration What you will learn:

1. Inventory Tracking and Monitoring

Task: The intern will assist in monitoring inventory levels, ensuring that stock levels are updated accurately in the system. This may involve conducting physical counts, updating inventory records, and checking stock for accuracy. 

Expected Result: The intern should contribute to maintaining accurate inventory records, minimizing discrepancies between actual stock and system data. They will help ensure that the company avoids stockouts or overstocking, improving inventory efficiency.

2. Stock Replenishment and Order Processing

Task: The intern will assist in processing stock replenishment orders based on inventory levels. This may involve reviewing stock reports, identifying items that need to be restocked, and preparing purchase orders. 

Expected Result: The intern should ensure that inventory is replenished on time by helping to identify low-stock items and ensure that purchase orders are processed efficiently. This will help maintain uninterrupted supply levels and prevent delays in operations.

3. Inventory Reporting and Documentation

Task: The intern will help generate daily, weekly, or monthly inventory reports, including stock levels, movements, and discrepancies. They may also assist in creating records for new inventory arrivals. 

Expected Result: The intern should produce clear and accurate reports that provide insight into inventory trends and performance. These reports will help management make informed decisions about stock levels, procurement, and distribution.

4. Assisting with Stock Audits and Reconciliations

Task: The intern will assist in performing regular stock audits, comparing physical inventory with the system records, and identifying any discrepancies. This may also include supporting stock reconciliation efforts after audits. 

Expected Result: The intern should help identify inventory discrepancies and work with the team to correct them, ensuring that inventory records are accurate. This contributes to maintaining the integrity of the inventory system and ensures compliance with internal controls.

5. Inventory System Management and Data Entry

Task: The intern will assist with updating inventory information in the management system. This includes entering new stock, adjusting quantities based on shipments or returns, and ensuring that product details are up-to-date. 

Expected Result: The intern should ensure that inventory data in the system is accurate and timely. Their work will help maintain an efficient inventory system, facilitating better decision-making and smoother operations.

Title: Marketing Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Marketing Description: The Marketing Intern will assist the marketing team in executing various tasks related to market research, campaign planning, content creation, and promotional activities. Conduct research on industry trends, competitor analysis, customer insights, and market demand. Analyze online sources, social media trends, and customer feedback. Provide reports with key growth opportunities and areas for marketing improvement. Create content for platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn (posts, basic graphics, scheduling). Help with planning and executing marketing campaigns (email newsletters, promotions, events). Develop and distribute marketing materials (brochures, flyers, product sheets, presentations). Coordinate with vendors for printing and distribution, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality materials.
