Required skills: Content Marketing, Collaboration, Communication, Data Analysis, Data Management, Database Management, Digital Marketing, Event Planning, Graphics and Design, Image editing, Market Research, Media Planning, Project Management, Relationship Management, Research, Social Media Management, Time Management Preferred skills: Adobe After Effects, Adobe Illustrator Required backgrounds: Business administration, Communication & journalism, Marketing What you will learn:

1. Market Research and Competitor Analysis

Task: The intern will gather data on industry trends, customer preferences, and competitors marketing strategies. This could involve analyzing social media, websites, and product offerings of competitors. 

Expected Result: The intern should produce a summary of key findings that can inform marketing strategies, such as identifying market gaps, customer needs, and new opportunities for the brand. The result should help improve the company's competitive edge.

2. Brand Development and Creative Projects

Task: The intern will assist in developing and maintaining brand materials. This could involve working on marketing presentations, updating marketing collaterals (e.g., brochures, flyers), or supporting creative brainstorming sessions for new campaigns. 

Expected Result: The intern should produce high-quality creative assets that align with the brands guidelines, contributing to consistent messaging and visual identity across all marketing channels. They will also support the brand's development by providing fresh, innovative ideas.

3. Administrative Support and Reporting

Task: The intern will support the marketing team with various administrative tasks, such as organizing meetings, preparing marketing reports, updating databases, and managing marketing calendars. 

Expected Result: The intern should ensure smooth day-to-day operations within the marketing department, contributing to the team's efficiency. Their work will help the department stay organized and on track with deadlines.

4. Customer Engagement and Community Management

Task: The intern will help manage customer inquiries and comments on social media platforms, respond to direct messages, and engage with customers in a friendly and professional manner. 

Expected Result: The intern should help build a positive online community by maintaining an active presence and responding to customer queries promptly. This will contribute to a stronger brand-customer relationship.

Title: Business Process Management Intern Programme: Global Talent Field: Engineering Description: The BPM Analyst is responsible for mapping, analyzing, and optimizing processes across multiple departments to enhance efficiency and reduce operational risks. This role involves process improvement initiatives, managing projects, facilitating communication, and leveraging technical proficiency to implement innovative solutions. Map and document existing processes across multiple departments Analyze processes for inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and risks Identify improvement opportunities and recommend solutions Benchmark processes against industry best practices Lead the implementation of process improvement initiatives Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders Conduct training and workshops for process improvements Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and ensure clear communication among team members Prepare and maintain documentation of processes, improvements, and best practices Coordinate with vendors and external partners as needed About the organisation: Frozen Meat and Seafood Supplier in the Philippines Consistent Frozen Solutions is the leading frozen meat supplier in the Philippines, trusted by the top restaurants, meat processors, and supermarkets. We provide an easy and hassle-free buying experience that gives our customers peace of mind. Required skills: Adaptability, Analytical thinking, Auto-CAD, Collaboration, Communication, Critical Thinking, Data Analysis, Data Analytics, Data Management, Data Science, Database Management, Detail oriented, Ergonomics, ERP, Manufacturing Technology, Operations Research, Process Engineering, Project Management, Research, Slack Required backgrounds: Industrial engineering, Statistics, Environmental engineering What you will learn:

1. Process Mapping and Documentation

Task: The intern will assist in mapping out business processes using process flowcharts or diagrams. This may involve shadowing senior BPM professionals to learn the methodology and tools used to document processes. 

Expected Result: The intern should be able to accurately create or update process maps for key business workflows, ensuring that all steps are documented clearly and follow the BPM standards. This will contribute to improved process transparency and can be used for process optimization initiatives.

2. Data Collection and Analysis

Task: The intern will gather data related to various business processes, including performance metrics, feedback from teams, and historical data on process efficiency. They may also assist in tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ongoing projects. 

Expected Result: The intern should be able to collect accurate data and organize it for further analysis. This will support the identification of inefficiencies and areas for improvement, contributing to data-driven decision-making for process improvement.

3. Supporting Process Improvement Initiatives

Task: The intern will assist in analyzing existing processes and identifying areas for improvement. They may be asked to research best practices or help implement small improvements. 

Expected Result: The intern should propose at least one actionable improvement suggestion during their internship, and ideally assist in implementing minor changes that result in tangible efficiency gains (e.g., reducing bottlenecks, improving communication).

4. Stakeholder Communication and Reporting

Task: The intern will support the BPM team in preparing reports and updates for stakeholders. This may include gathering feedback from team members, summarizing project progress, and communicating updates to department heads. 

Expected Result: The intern should produce clear, concise reports and presentations that reflect the current state of BPM initiatives and communicate any challenges or achievements to stakeholders in a timely manner.

5. Tool and Software Management Support

Task: The intern will assist in using business process management software tools or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems to monitor, track, and manage projects. They may be asked to update dashboards or help maintain the data in these tools.

Expected Result: The intern should become proficient in the BPM and ERP tools being used and contribute to keeping systems up to date. The interns efforts should help ensure accurate data input and facilitate better project tracking for the BPM team.

  • Engage in or organize teaching-related activities, including demos, conversation clubs, tutorials, seminars, workshops and extracurricular events.
  • Assist in marketing activities and participate in the Center's social events.

3. Flexibility in Substitution:

  • Be ready to substitute for absent colleagues, either on-site or off-site, even at short notice.

  • Join activities/ workshops with schools.

7. Work location

  • Teaches permanently at 2 schools in Go Cong and Cho Gao.
  • Sometimes teachers teach at the other 2 schools for about 1 to 2 weeks.

10. Working time: from Monday to Sunday (1 day off)

Title: English Teaching Programme: Global Teacher Description: Teaching english people, students and adults + ESP(English for specific purposes) About the organisation: Exam test and preparation Center for IELTS and TOEFL English for all Levels Required skills: Language Teaching Required backgrounds: Education What you will learn:

  • Month 1: Onboarding and Classroom Setup**

1. Orientation & Training**:

- Attend onboarding sessions to familiarize yourself with the school or organizations teaching methodologies, curriculum, and resources.

- Participate in professional development workshops to align with institutional goals and standards.

2. Classroom Environment Setup**:

- Set up a conducive learning environment in your physical or virtual classroom.

- Ensure access to teaching tools, such as digital platforms, textbooks, and resources.

3. Student Assessment & Course Planning**:

- Conduct initial student assessments to determine their language levels, goals, and needs.

- Develop lesson plans based on the curriculum and student proficiency levels.

- Plan both general English lessons and any specialized lessons (e.g., English for Business, Academic English, etc.).

---

  • Month 2: Establishing the Learning Foundation**

1. Core Language Skill Development**:

- Focus on basic language skills (grammar, vocabulary, listening, speaking, reading, and writing) across all student levels.

- Incorporate interactive lessons, such as group discussions, vocabulary exercises, and grammar drills.

2. Setting Learning Goals**:

- Work with students to set realistic language-learning goals and track progress over time.

- Implement a system for continuous assessment (quizzes, class participation, assignments).

3. Student Engagement**:

- Introduce activities to build rapport with students (icebreakers, debates, role-plays) and establish an engaging classroom atmosphere.

- Use multimedia (videos, podcasts, language apps) to keep lessons dynamic.

---

  • Month 3: Diversified Teaching and Assessment**

1. Introduce Specialized English Topics**:

- Start introducing specialized topics for students with specific goals (e.g., Business English, IELTS/TOEFL preparation, ESP for professionals).

- Use case studies, role-playing, and practical scenarios to immerse students in specialized contexts.

2. Mid-Term Assessments**:

- Conduct mid-term exams or project-based assessments to gauge student progress and identify areas for improvement.

- Provide individual feedback to students and recommend strategies for improvement.

3. Professional Development**:

- Attend conferences, webinars, or workshops to improve teaching techniques.

- Collaborate with other English teachers or join language teaching communities to exchange ideas and best practices.

---

  • Month 4: Advanced Language Skills and Personalized Instruction**

1. Focus on Advanced Skills**:

- For higher-level students, focus on advanced language skills like nuanced writing, critical reading, public speaking, and academic writing.

- Encourage creativity through assignments like essays, presentations, or debates on complex topics.

2. One-on-One Sessions**:

- Offer personalized tutoring or one-on-one sessions to address individual student challenges or advanced learning goals.

- Focus on specific student weaknesses, such as pronunciation, fluency, or specialized vocabulary.

3. Classroom Management Techniques**:

- Refine classroom management strategies to handle larger or more diverse student groups effectively.

- Implement peer learning and collaborative exercises to foster a supportive learning community.

---

  • Month 5: Intensive Skill Building and External Collaboration**

1. Real-World Application**:

- Integrate real-world activities like mock interviews, business correspondence, or field-specific presentations for professional students.

- Organize group projects or case studies based on real-life English usage in specific industries or academic fields.

2. Collaborate with External Stakeholders**:

- Collaborate with industry professionals, guest speakers, or other departments to offer students real-world insights and language exposure.

- Organize cross-departmental or external activities (e.g., language workshops, public speaking contests).

3. Final Exam Preparation**:

- Start preparing students for their final assessments or external exams (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS).

- Provide students with practice exams, review sessions, and test-taking strategies to improve their confidence and performance.

---

Month 6: Final Assessments and Professional Growth**

1. Final Student Assessments**:

- Administer final exams, presentations, or project-based assessments to evaluate students progress over the course.

- Provide comprehensive feedback and reports on their strengths and areas of improvement.

2. Professional Reflection & Improvement**:

- Reflect on your own teaching experience over the last six months.

- Gather student feedback through surveys or discussions to assess the effectiveness of your teaching methods and materials.

- Plan for areas of personal improvement, such as developing new lesson plans, learning new teaching technologies, or pursuing certification (e.g., CELTA, TEFL).

3. Networking and Career Development**:

- Attend a language teaching conference or join a professional association (TESOL, IATEFL) to network with peers and explore new career opportunities.

- Update your teaching portfolio or resume to showcase new skills and accomplishments from the last six months.

---

Title: ACE Program | Spanish Talent Acquisition Specialist Programme: Global Talent Description: The ACE Program is a career development partnership between TCS and AIESEC that has the objective of providing youth with exposure to highly qualified professional experiences. This Role plays a key role in exploring our capabilities of staffing requirements. Hence we need to hire a candidate who understands the role. The role is centered on Global Talent Acquisition. About the organisation: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) is a leading Indian multinational information technology (IT) services and consulting company within the Tata Group. Headquartered in Mumbai, TCS operates in 46 countries and is recognized as one of the world's most valuable IT services brands. Notably, TCS became the first Indian IT firm to reach a valuation of $200 billion, securing its position as one of India's largest companies by market value​. In collaboration with AIESEC, TCS launched the ACE (Accelerate, Connect, and Experience) Program in 2004, an international career initiative that brings young global talent to TCS offices worldwide. This program not only enriches TCS’s workforce with diverse perspectives but also offers participants a platform to build highly qualified careers. Since its inception, over 3000 young professionals from around the world have participated in the ACE program, with many continuing their careers in TCS across various global branches. The program remains a vital part of TCS's mission to foster innovation through diversity and inclusivity, ensuring a dynamic and globally-oriented workplace culture. Preferred skills: Communication, Presentation skills, Team Management Preferred backgrounds: Human Resources What you will learn:
  • Achieve staffing objectives by sourcing the right candidates for the open and critical positions.
  • Maintain relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure staffing goals are fulfilled.
  • Screening candidates as per TCS eligibility criteria and assisting with the candidate registration process at the TCS careers page.
  • Evaluate applicants by discussing job requirements and applicant qualifications with Hiring managers.
  • Communicating employer information and benefits during the screening process.
  • Source potential candidates from databases, internal/social media platforms, and employee referral programs.
  • Advertise job openings on the TCS careers page, social media, job boards.
  • Engage with vendor partners as per hiring guidelines to fulfill requirements.
  • Provide periodic sourcing reports to respective stakeholders.

Title: English Teacher Programme: Global Teacher Description: We are looking for candidates who can speak fluent or C1+ English in our kindergarten. About the organisation: Our school BrightKids is one of the most preferred and recommended kindergartens in its locations since its establishment. Our modern curriculum based on the California/USA early childhood education model and our experienced team who apply this curriculum with love and skill are the main sources of our success. In our kindergartens, we provide education to the children of both Turkish and foreign families. Thanks to our small groups, our programs support the strengths of each of our children and respond to their developmental needs. To summarize what will make up your child's experience in our schools… A world full of educational material, creative ideas, a loving environment where they learn to build positive relationships with their peers, take responsibility and develop friendships. Our philosophy Our primary goal in early childhood education is to make children happy, have fun at school and feel safe. With the support of the creative environment we provide and their teachers, we enable them to acquire early age intellectual skills such as problem solving and decision making, and reinforce their desire to learn. To us, a kindergarten program is much more than a written format of what to do in the classroom. We take every opportunity to teach, and we take our schedules far beyond what to do in the classroom, to our dining room, play hours, entertainment, and even songs. We don't wait to enter classrooms to teach and we never miss an opportunity. Our Mission Our Mission; To contribute to the growth of our children as multicultural, self-confident individuals who can understand and adapt to the rapidly globalizing world by raising them in two languages. Preferred skills: Windows PC usage, Internet usage Required backgrounds: Education Preferred backgrounds: Linguistics, Literature What you will learn:

1-Taking care of the needs of the assigned class (12-14 people - 2-6 years old students) throughout the day.

2- Organizing fun educational activities around themes every day

3-Creating daily/weekly education plans

4-Creating regular reports for parents about their children's daily activities at school.

5-To hold periodic parent meetings with the Turkish partner and to make progress evaluations including the results of the observations.

6. Attending special days and holiday events with the kids and other staff in the designated days of the event.
